name: Merchant's Ledger
description: A dog-eared account book, more gossip than sums.
paragraphs: 12 bolts of wool, sold to the tailor on Cooper's Row -- he still owes me for the last batch, the old skinflint.
Note to self: the road east of the mill is not safe after dark. Lost a whole cart of salted fish to something that left no footprints and no receipt.
